truthAudit.Summary: Audited Run 1 against the supplied source and visible truth set. Run 1 directly found or partially found 14 of the 20 true vulnerabilities and missed 6. Several findings required severity or CWE corrections, and a few overclaims or non-credible findings were admitted.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Dynamic printf format string from configurable log format
Items.Notes: The previous answer directly reported runtime log_format being used as a printf format string, matching the truth anchors for runtime_log_format and printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input).
No previous finding discussed the factorial lambda and the result *= i integer overflow.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free of history scratch buffers after memory pool cleanup
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified scratch buffers enqueued from stage_deferred_history_flush and subsequent memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup, matching the use-after-free truth item. Severity was underreported.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Shell command injection from config values in validate_config
Items.Notes: The previous finding quoted validator_cmd, config_file, command concatenation, and system(command.c_str()) in validate_config, matching the truth item. Severity was underreported.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Inverted length check causes strcpy stack buffer overflow
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified the inverted length guard causing strcpy into input_buffer_, matching the stack buffer overflow truth item. Severity was overreported and the CWE set was narrower than the truth item.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: ThreadSafeCounter::increment reads value outside the mutex
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified old_value being read before the lock in ThreadSafeCounter::increment, matching the thread-pool counter race. Severity was underreported and CWE-364 was used instead of CWE-362.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Admin emergency override grants authentication without valid credentials
Items.Notes: The previous finding reported login_attempts_ > 5, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE substring, and authenticated_ = true, matching the logic bomb truth item. Severity was overreported and CWE-287 was a weaker classification than CWE-511.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Path traversal in admin load config command
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified config_dir_ + filename in load_config and admin load traversal, matching the truth item.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Heap buffer overflow from unbounded strcpy in expression parser
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified the 256-byte expression_buffer_ and unbounded strcpy in the expression parser, matching the heap overflow truth item. Severity was underreported and CWE-787 should be refined to CWE-122.
The previous finding identified ADMIN_SECRET and SC_ENT_2025_AUTH in authentication, matching the truth item.

The previous finding reported the 4-digit uniform_int_distribution token generator and weak session randomness, with a line range that includes the std::mt19937 usage. It did not explicitly emphasize the PRNG flaw enough, and severity/CWE were underreported.
No previous finding reported the static std::tm cached_time and localtime data race in log_debug_message.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Shell command injection via environment-controlled audit log path
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified TEMP/TMPDIR-controlled audit_path passed to system(), which contains the insecure temporary file handling issue, but framed it primarily as command injection and overreported severity.
No previous finding reported persistent authentication state via authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ without expiration or revocation.
No previous finding reported the unhandled std::stod exception in handle_variable_command for invalid variable values.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unsigned integer underflow in MemoryPool allocation can create out-of-bounds fragment pointer
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES underflow and fragment.size assignment, matching the truth item. Severity was underreported.
No previous finding reported unbounded recursion between parse_expression, parse_term, parse_factor, and PAREN_OPEN.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unsynchronized result_cache_ access in expression evaluator
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified unsynchronized result_cache_ access in evaluate_cached with cache_mutex_ present but unused, matching the truth item. Severity was overreported.
No previous finding reported the TOCTOU between std::filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and std::ifstream in load_config.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero on empty input
Items.Notes: The previous finding identified calculate_route_score dividing by token_length, including the empty-input case, matching the truth item. Severity was overreported.
